description: Presidential Secretariat - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2103/33, that published Duties and Functions of Ministries
categorisation: This gazette contains both the naming of a specific individual (President Maithripala Sirisena) and detailed descriptions of ministerial portfolio responsibilities, including specific subject areas, departments, and legislation assigned to the Ministers of Agriculture and Public Administration. This meets the criteria for a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3) as it includes both "who" (government person) and "what" (detailed government responsibilities/portfolios).
